netlist:
ce_noise
Vcc supply 0 12
Vin in 0 DC 0 AC 1 SIN(0 1m 1k)
Cin in base 10u
Rtop supply base 100k
Rbottom base 0 22k
Rc supply out 2.2k
Re1 emitter bypass 100
Re2 bypass 0 900
Ce bypass 0 100u
Q1 out base emitter q
.model q NPN(IS=1e-15 BF=150 BR=3 VAF=100 VAR=30 IKF=50m RB=40 RC=2 RE=1 CJE=20p CJC=8p TF=400p TR=20n)
.options reltol=1e-6 vntol=1e-9
.noise v(out) Vin dec 3 10 10k
.control
set numdgt=15
set wr_singlescale
set wr_vecnames
run
setplot noise1
let value0 = onoise_spectrum
let value1 = inoise_spectrum
wrdata reference.dat value0 value1
setplot noise2
wrdata reference_total.dat onoise_total inoise_total
quit
.endc
.end
